input.summary: Add mutual successor carve-out on written notice and a reasonableness standard to the consent requirement.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual carve-out permitting assignment to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets on written notice, and made the consent required for other assignments subject to a reasonableness standard. This is our fallback assignment position; the existing affiliate carve-out is unchanged.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Neither party shall assign or transfer its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, except no approval is required for assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or, upon written notice, to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets.
